meta.note: Values copied from the GardenPilot screen reference sheet, which mirrors packages/lvgl/page_home.yaml and the Stitch DESIGN.md export.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background behind everything; the only page ground on the device.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Zone cards (Greenhouse, Lawn, bed cards) sitting on `bg`.

tokens.name: status
tokens.usage: Inset status blocks inside a card, the bottom nav bar and inactive nav buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px card outlines and full-width dividers under the header. Decorative only (1.85:1 on `card`): never the sole carrier of state — state uses the fill colours.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of progress bars (soil moisture).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Values and primary labels on `bg`, `card` and `status` (13.3:1 on `card`).

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Captions (GREENHOUSE, SOIL MOISTURE, STATUS, NEXT), inactive nav, ghost-button outline and text, idle/no-data values, icons. 10.1:1 on `card`, 9.7:1 on `status`.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Brand title and 'active' text: Watering, Running: Bed N. On `bg`/`card`/`status` ≥9.6:1.

tokens.name: green-fill
tokens.usage: Active nav button, RUN buttons, greenhouse soil bar, top edge + border of a running bed card, Auto-mode switch on.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `green-fill` (4.58:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Lawn / water accent: lawn soil bar on the Home card, humidity and drop icons.

tokens.name: blue-fill
tokens.usage: RUN QUEUE and WATER NOW buttons, top edge + border of a queued bed card, lawn soil bar on the Lawn page (3.9:1 on `track`).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on `blue-fill` (4.57:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warning text (reserved; from the Stitch palette, not yet used on a built screen).

tokens.name: amber-fill
tokens.usage: Warning fill, e.g. a paused bed (reserved; not yet used on a built screen).

tokens.name: error-fill
tokens.usage: STOP button only — the one destructive action.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on `error-fill` (7.2:1).

families.sans: Montserrat, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase section captions and nav labels; LVGL montserrat_8.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status text, clock, button labels, screen titles; LVGL montserrat_10.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Sensor readings and bed durations; LVGL montserrat_12.

styles.name: value-lg
styles.usage: The single headline reading of a page (Lawn soil); LVGL montserrat_14.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Screensaver clock only; custom font gp_font_clock (digits, colon, dash).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between the two Home cards; inner inset of a status card (x).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between nav buttons; card label inset; status-card text inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Screen edge margin on Home; gap between bed cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen edge margin on detail pages (Greenhouse, Lawn).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and status cards.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav buttons, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch track (14px tall) — half its height.

tokens.name: screen-w
tokens.usage: Display width; every layout is absolute x/y inside it, as in LVGL.

tokens.name: screen-h
tokens.usage: Display height.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header band; the divider sits at y=21–22.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Bottom nav bar on Home (y=201).

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Progress bar height on cards (6px for a page's headline bar).

tokens.name: btn-h-sm
tokens.usage: In-card buttons (RUN, +Q).

tokens.name: btn-h-md
tokens.usage: Page transport buttons (STOP, RUN QUEUE, HOME, WATER NOW).
